# Verify Compilation

The verify compilation feature performs a shadow compile to check if the current state of the repository matches the expected compiled state. It ensures that there are no divergent changes, providing a way to validate the integrity of the knowledge base against the latest inputs.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
